release: Komorebi Physics Lean v0.37.0 — Checked Block 37

proved_claims.claim: Every octree digit is exactly equivalent to three Cartesian bits.
The finite digit encoding preserves the uniform probability measure.
The digitwise infinite-address encoding preserves the full product measure.
The address equivalence induces an exact L2 linear isometry.
Base-two decoding gives a continuous, measurable, surjective map onto the closed Euclidean unit cube.
The cube is a topological quotient of both the bit-address and octree-address spaces.
A common prefix of length n bounds every coordinate discrepancy by 2^-n.
Binary decoding is not injective; two distinct streams represent one half.

explicit_nonclaims: The binary decoder is not proved to push fair-bit product measure to Lebesgue volume.
No almost-everywhere measurable equivalence between the address continuum and the Euclidean cube is proved.
The Block 36 L2 density theorem is not yet transported to Euclidean-volume L2.
No continuum Dirac generator consistency or propagator convergence theorem is proved.
No dynamical gauge field, gravity, cosmology, or empirical prediction is established by this block.
